text:
maya: Deploy-bot flagged EU canary p95 + error-rate spike on inference-service kv-cache. Recommending quick decision: manual rollback or pin?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary metrics: p95 latency 1.9s -> 3.8s (+100%), error-rate 0.4% -> 3.6% (5min window). Affected model variant: redwood/model-infer:v2.7.3-canary. Link: https://telemetry/redwood/canary/6190004321

sam: How many dedicated customers hit the canary? Any high-SLA ones? :eyes:

leo: Two EU dedicated pools saw degraded tail latencies, one had embedding job timeouts. I'm for a targeted rollback (canary slice only) rather than full org-wide revert.

nina: If we do a targeted rollback we still need a release-note blurb + customer note for the two affected accounts. Also change window for EU maintenance ends in 45m — do we have ops stamp?

maya: I'll take ops stamp. Plan: pin canary traffic back to v2.7.2 and abort further canary rollouts. Steps in runbook:
```
# runbook excerpt
rwctl traffic set --service=inference-eu --slice=canary --version=v2.7.2
rwctl rollout abort --service=inference-eu --policy=canary
# verify
rwctl metrics tail --service=inference-eu --filter=p95,error-rate
```
Executing now.

sam: I'll update release-notes with "hotfix: canary revert v2.7.3 -> v2.7.2" and ping CS + account leads.

deploy-bot: [UPDATE] Rollback initiated by maya at 2026-03-21T10:12:45Z. Observed p95 back to 1.0-1.2s after ~90s. Error-rate trending down.

leo: Good. Make sure we also pin Dedicated pool to prevent auto-rollout of v2.7.3 until postmortem. Add a short TTL pin or manual approval gate.

maya: Done — pinned dedicated-pool-eu to v2.7.2 and created ticket RN-6190 for postmortem + communication. Notifying legal for customer impact classification.

nina: Customer comms draft (short): "We briefly reverted a canary update for EU inference due to elevated latency; no data loss. We are investigating and will follow up with a full postmortem." I'll send to CS for review.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll attach the rollback command + telemetry snaps to the release-notes entry.

maya: Closing the immediate action. Leaving the ticket open for postmortem and fix PR. Thanks everyone.
